To generate a speciﬁc test dataset, we ﬁrst optimize the structures of the selected materials at 0 K and then perform ab initio molecular dynamics (AIMD) simulations for 100 ps under the NVT ensemble. Each system is gradually heated from 300 to 1200 K to probe the PES across the temperature range typically used for simulating Li diffusion in SSEs. Test conﬁgurations are sampled every 200 fs, resulting in 500 structures per material.

For non-argyrodite types, the test set includes nine well-known Li SSE materials: oxides (Li7La3Zr2O12; LLZO, Li1:33Ti1:67Al0:33ðPO4Þ3; LATP)62,63, sulﬁdes (Li10GeP2S12; LGPS, Li7P3S11; LPS)64,65, halides (Li3YCl6; LYC, Li3YBr6; LYB)66, nitrides (Li3N, Li9S3N; LSN)67,68, and hydrides (LiBH4)69.
